## Biography

The Cobra is a family of compact, manoeuvrable starships manufactured by Faulcon DeLacy, most famously the Cobra Mk III. Known for its speed, affordability, and adaptability, the Cobra has long been a favourite among independent pilots for smuggling, bounty hunting, and exploration. It remains one of the most recognisable ship designs in human space.
